test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 7 Oct 2021 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
**Select the most appropriate word to fill in the blank.**

The teacher was very_______. She never let anyone play pranks in her class.
solution: The correct answer is '**strict**'. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The most appropriate word for the given blank is '**strict**'. • It means** 'not allowing people to break rules or behave badly'.** [सख्‍़त, कठोर (नियम भंग या ग़लत व्‍यवहार को सहन न करने वाला)] • *Example: Samir is very **strict** with his children.* • The later part of the sentence states that the teacher doesn't like it if someone plays pranks in the class. • Hence, '**strict**' is the most suitable word for the given blank. **Correct Sentence:__** *The teacher was very **strict**. She never let anyone play pranks in her class.* [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** • Let's look at the **meaning **of other words: • **Happy**: feeling or showing pleasure; pleased. (आनंद का अनुभव करने या उसे व्‍यक्त करने वाला; प्रसन्‍न, प्रफुल्‍ल) • **Lenient**: (used about punishment or person who punishes) not as strict as expected. [(दंड या दंड देने वाला व्‍यक्ति) जो आशा के अनुरूप कठोर न हो; नरम, सौम्‍य] • **Jovial**: (used about a person) happy and friendly. [(व्‍यक्ति) प्रसन्‍न और मित्रवत] 41:T653, The correct answer is** 'No substitution required'.**
